candidates.explanation: After verifying the reset hash and updating the password, the method never invalidates the user's existing sessions. The refresh flow (refreshToken -> sessionService.updateByHash) keeps working for sessions created before the reset, so already signed-in devices can still renew their login. The method should delete all sessions for the user (e.g. sessionService.deleteByUserId) after the password update.

fix.description: Inject SessionService (already used in validateLogin) and, after `await this.usersService.update(user.id, user);` in resetPassword, call `await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id });` so all existing sessions/refresh tokens are revoked on password reset.
